## Set up the battery

- Size (for example 100 MW / 200 MWh), round-trip efficiency (about 85%), and
  one charge-discharge cycle per day.
- Simplifications: price-taker, no degradation, no ancillary-service revenue.

## Strategies

- Perfect hindsight: charge in each day's cheapest 2 hours, sell in the most
  expensive 2. The upper bound.
- Day-ahead rule: choose the hours using only day-ahead prices, known in advance.
- Forecast rule: choose the hours using the forecast from notebook 03.
